svg.aria-label: A stylised desktop conversation with the workflow progress view next to it. The user sends /lgtmgate:deliver 142 with a one-line brief. A workflow card appears in the conversation and the run appears in a background tasks panel, which lists the phases as they start: Setup, Diagnose, Plan, Dev, Review, each with its agents. The first review asks for changes, so a Review 2 phase opens with the fix and a second review. The run ends on a pull request that is ready, and the conversation says it waits for the go-ahead of the user to merge.

One command hands GitHub issue #142 to the agents.
An agent checks the issue is real before anyone writes a plan.
The plan is posted on the issue with its acceptance checklist.
The code is written and a draft pull request is opened.
A different agent checks each checklist item against evidence.
The dev agent fixes, then the review runs again.
The pull request is ready. The merge waits for your go-ahead.
